findings.title: Preserve explicit escaping against cross-site scripting
findings.body: Line 45 moves autoescape=True from Jinja's Environment constructor into Starlette's deprecated environment-options forwarding path. Installed Starlette 0.52.1 emits a DeprecationWarning recommending the previous implementation. Escaping works today, as verified with an HTML payload, but Docker installs unconstrained dependencies without uv.lock. This makes the protection version-dependent. If escaping lapses, values such as entry.name in templates/partials/search_log.html:19 could execute injected HTML. This is a deprecated-control dependency, not a demonstrated current XSS exploit.
findings.recommendation: Retain the explicit jinja2.Environment(autoescape=True) and pass it through Jinja2Templates(env=...), as before.
